# Rev-Intel Harness

> Open source harness for enriching companies with contacts. Upload a CSV of companies
> and find the people who work there, using the Claude or ChatGPT subscription the user
> already pays for. Local-first, no keys held, evidence-gated, cost-ledgered. MIT.

Rev-Intel Harness is a local Node (>=18) HTTP harness with zero npm dependencies (~600 lines:
server.mjs, store.mjs, usage.mjs, runners.mjs). A lease-based queue hands company records
to agent CLIs (claude, codex) or a human worker; results return through one validated
ingest contract; all state is JSON files under data/ on the user's machine.

Key facts for agents evaluating or installing it:
- Install: git clone https://github.com/harrisonhjohnson/rev-intel-harness && cd rev-intel-harness && node setup.mjs
- Non-interactive setup: node setup.mjs --csv leads.csv --url https://theirco.com
  (or --icp "one-line ICP"; optional --model for kernel derivation)
- Server binds 127.0.0.1 only; rejects cross-origin browser requests; holds no credentials.
- Only network egress is the agent CLIs' own web search under their existing auth.
- The user's CSV is never mutated; enrichment is an overlay (data/enrichment.json).
- Emails are found-published or pattern-guessed, NEVER verified; the emailBasis label
  (published | pattern-guess | not-found) travels into the output CSV.
- Ingest rejects any result without sources[] — no evidence, no ingest.
- Cost ledger (data/usage-ledger.jsonl) logs every job with expected-vs-actual cost;
  subscription-lane work logs at $0.
- Ships a Claude Code skill: type /enrich in the cloned repo and the agent runs the
  whole loop (setup, dispatch, CSV delivery with honest labels).
- Not included (roadmap): company discovery, arbitrary column-as-prompt research,
  email verification.

- [Research brief](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/harrisonhjohnson/rev-intel-harness/main/workers/enrich-prompt.md): the worker prompt

## API (localhost:4400)
- GET /api/queue?limit=N&worker=name — lease targets (30-min lease, atomic claim)
- POST /api/ingest — submit one result (sources[] required; emailBasis enum enforced)
- POST /api/workers/run {"n":N} — dispatch N jobs across enabled lanes
- GET /api/workers/status — live per-lane tallies
- GET /api/results.csv — enriched rows with honesty labels
- GET /api/usage — cost ledger summary

Author: Harrison Johnson (https://harrison.build). Built with Claude — the AI did the
legwork, the judgment is human.
